title.pl: Park nad rzeką w Starym Mieście

description.en: A scenic waterfront promenade along the river with benches, walking paths, and sunset views. Always open for a peaceful stroll or picnic.
description.pl: Malowniczy bulwar nad rzeką z ławkami, ścieżkami spacerowymi i widokami zachodu słońca. Otwarty całą dobę na spokojny spacer lub piknik.

sourceComments.author: Marta K.
sourceComments.text: Perfect for an evening stroll. Benches along the water and stunning sunset views.

sourceComments.author: John S.
sourceComments.text: Peaceful promenade away from the busy square. Great for picnics.

sourceComments.author: Ewa L.
sourceComments.text: Always open and wheelchair accessible. Our favorite spot to unwind.

description.en: A sprawling urban park with old oak trees, playgrounds, and open meadows. Perfect for yoga, jogging, or a lazy afternoon.
description.pl: Rozległy park miejski ze starymi dębami, placami zabaw i otwartymi łąkami. Idealny na jogę, jogging lub leniwe popołudnie.

sourceComments.author: Tomasz P.
sourceComments.text: Huge oaks, good playgrounds, and plenty of space for jogging or yoga.

sourceComments.author: Amy R.
sourceComments.text: Gets busy on sunny weekends but still feels spacious. Dawn visits are quietest.

sourceComments.author: Natalia W.
sourceComments.text: Family favorite. Kids love the meadows and we love the shade in summer.

description.en: A calm lake surrounded by a 3 km trail loop. Rent kayaks in summer, feed ducks year-round, or simply enjoy the water views.
description.pl: Spokojne jezioro otoczone 3 km pętlą tras. Wynajem kajaków latem, karmienie kaczek przez cały rok lub po prostu widoki na wodę.

sourceComments.author: Piotr Z.
sourceComments.text: Calm lake with a lovely 3 km trail. Kayak rental in summer is worth it.

sourceComments.author: Laura M.
sourceComments.text: Beautiful year-round. Feeding ducks is fun for kids — bring bird-safe snacks.

sourceComments.author: Kasia H.
sourceComments.text: Open 24 hours and free. Best at sunrise when the water is mirror-still.

description.en: A shaded 5 km forest path through pine and birch woodland. Birdwatching, mushroom foraging, and fresh air away from the city bustle.
description.pl: Zacieniona 5 km leśna ścieżka przez sosnowy i brzozowy las. Obserwacja ptaków, grzybobranie i świeże powietrze z dala od zgiełku miasta.

sourceComments.author: Adam F.
sourceComments.text: Shaded forest path — cool even on hot days. Saw woodpeckers and deer tracks.

sourceComments.author: Chris B.
sourceComments.text: Well marked trail through pine and birch. Wear proper shoes after rain.

sourceComments.author: Monika S.
sourceComments.text: Fresh air escape from the city. Mushroom foragers were friendly and helpful.

description.en: Permanent exhibitions on local history from medieval times to the present. Interactive displays, audio guides, and a rooftop terrace.
description.pl: Stałe wystawy historii lokalnej od średniowiecza po dziś. Interaktywne ekspozycje, przewodniki audio i taras na dachu.

sourceComments.author: Barbara T.
sourceComments.text: Excellent exhibitions from medieval times onward. Audio guides and rooftop terrace are highlights.

sourceComments.author: Michael D.
sourceComments.text: Interactive displays keep kids engaged. Closed Mondays — plan ahead.

sourceComments.author: Zofia R.
sourceComments.text: Fully wheelchair accessible with elevator. Worth the entry fee.

description.en: Medieval castle ruins perched on a hill with panoramic city views. Explore towers, courtyards, and centuries of history at your own pace.
description.pl: Średniowieczne ruiny zamku na wzgórzu z panoramicznym widokiem na miasto. Wieże, dziedzińce i wieki historii we własnym tempie.

sourceComments.author: James L.
sourceComments.text: Panoramic city views from the hill. Ruins are atmospheric and well maintained.

sourceComments.author: Helen W.
sourceComments.text: Explore at your own pace. Golden hour from the towers is spectacular.

sourceComments.author: Marcin K.
sourceComments.text: Steep paths in places but seating areas help. History lovers will enjoy this.

description.en: Four hectares of themed gardens — rose pavilion, tropical greenhouse, and a Japanese zen corner. A year-round oasis of color and calm.
description.pl: Cztery hektary ogrodów tematycznych — pawilon róż, tropikalna szklarnia i japoński zen. Całoroczna oaza koloru i spokoju.

sourceComments.author: Anna P.
sourceComments.text: Rose pavilion and Japanese zen corner are stunning. Peaceful oasis all year.

sourceComments.author: Sophie G.
sourceComments.text: Four hectares of themed gardens — easy to spend half a day here.

sourceComments.author: Robert N.
sourceComments.text: Stroller-friendly paths and greenhouse is a hit with toddlers.

description.en: The city's best panoramic lookout over rooftops and the river valley. Benches, a small café, and unforgettable golden-hour views.
description.pl: Najlepszy punkt widokowy na dachy miasta i dolinę rzeki. Ławki, mała kawiarnia i niezapomniane widoki o złotej godzinie.

sourceComments.author: Ewa M.
sourceComments.text: Best golden-hour views in the city. Small café nearby for a drink while you wait.

sourceComments.author: Tomek J.
sourceComments.text: Open 24/7 and free. Benches face the river valley — perfect for couples.

sourceComments.author: Kate H.
sourceComments.text: Can get windy at night — bring a jacket. Worth every step up the hill.

description.en: Climbing frames, splash pad, mini train, and picnic areas designed for families. Free entry with optional snack kiosks.
description.pl: Place zabaw, brodzik, mini pociąg i strefy piknikowe dla rodzin. Wstęp wolny, opcjonalne kioski z przekąskami.

sourceComments.author: Katarzyna B.
sourceComments.text: Kids adore the splash pad and mini train. Free entry makes it a no-brainer for families.

sourceComments.author: Paweł S.
sourceComments.text: Busy on weekends but well designed. Picnic areas and snack kiosks on site.

sourceComments.author: Jenny L.
sourceComments.text: Climbing frames for all ages. Stroller-friendly and lots of shade.

description.en: The historic heart of the city — cobblestone plaza, cafés, street performers, and architecture dating back centuries. Always alive with activity.
description.pl: Historyczne serce miasta — brukowany plac, kawiarnie, uliczni artyści i architektura sprzed wieków. Zawsze tętni życiem.

sourceComments.author: Marek D.
sourceComments.text: Historic heart of the city — cobblestones, cafés, street performers. Always lively.

sourceComments.author: Paul R.
sourceComments.text: Beautiful architecture and great people-watching. Touristy but authentic.

sourceComments.author: Ola K.
sourceComments.text: Open around the clock. Evening atmosphere with lights is magical.

description.en: A lively 2 km boardwalk along the harbor with restaurants, benches, and public art installations. Great for an evening walk any day of the week.
description.pl: Tętniący życiem 2 km deptak wzdłuż portu z restauracjami, ławkami i instalacjami sztuki publicznej. Świetny na wieczorny spacer.

sourceComments.author: Chris A.
sourceComments.text: Lively 2 km boardwalk with restaurants and public art. Perfect evening walk.

sourceComments.author: Maria F.
sourceComments.text: Harbor views and benches every few meters. Wheelchair accessible throughout.

sourceComments.author: Daniel W.
sourceComments.text: Our go-to after dinner. Street musicians and sunset over the water.

description.en: Former factory buildings turned into open-air galleries and studios. Murals, sculptures, and pop-up exhibitions you can explore anytime.
description.pl: Dawne fabryki zamienione w galerie plenerowe i pracownie. Murale, rzeźby i wystawy pop-up, które można zwiedzać o każdej porze.

sourceComments.author: Art Lover
sourceComments.text: Former factories turned galleries — murals and sculptures everywhere. Explore anytime.

sourceComments.author: Nina C.
sourceComments.text: Open-air art you can visit on your own schedule. Great for photographers.

sourceComments.author: Jakub M.
sourceComments.text: Pop-up exhibitions change often. Industrial vibe meets creative energy.
